physical_layer_timing.embedded_clock: M-PHY uses an embedded/recovered clock; the host supplies REF_CLK to seed the device PLL.
physical_layer_timing.burst_oriented: Communication occurs in bursts separated by low-power idle (SLEEP / STALL / HIBERN8) states.

link_startup_sequence.step_1: Host releases RESET_n and enables the host controller (HCE=1).
link_startup_sequence.step_2: M-PHY performs lane discovery; UniPro DME executes the link startup sequence.
link_startup_sequence.step_3: Host issues UIC commands to negotiate power mode and HS-Gear (e.g. HS-Gear 5, 2 lanes).
link_startup_sequence.step_4: Host and device exchange NOP Out / NOP In to confirm the transport is up.
link_startup_sequence.step_5: Host sets fDeviceInit; device clears it when internal initialization completes.

write_transfer_waveform.step_1: Host submits a Command UPIU (WRITE) referencing a LUN and LBA range.
write_transfer_waveform.step_2: Device sends one or more Ready-To-Transfer (RTT) UPIUs granting write-data credit (bounded by bMaxNumOfRTT).
write_transfer_waveform.step_3: Host sends Data Out UPIUs up to the granted amount.
write_transfer_waveform.step_4: Device returns a Response UPIU with final status when the write completes.

read_transfer_waveform.step_2: Device returns Data In UPIUs with the read payload.
read_transfer_waveform.step_3: Device returns a Response UPIU with final status.

power_mode_transitions.HIBERN8_ENTER: Host requests HIBERN8 via UIC command; lanes park while retaining configuration for fast wake.
power_mode_transitions.HIBERN8_EXIT: Host or device activity triggers fast wake back to the previously negotiated gear.
power_mode_transitions.gear_change: PWM <-> HS-Gear transitions and lane-count changes are negotiated via the UniPro DME before high-speed transfer.

general_timing_rule: All high-speed bus timing is defined by the MIPI M-PHY 5.0 electrical specification (eye width/height, jitter, equalization per HS-Gear) and the UniPro v2.0 data-link timing (credit-based flow control, retransmission timeouts). The host-supplied REF_CLK frequency is selected via the bRefClkFreq attribute. Detailed electrical timing tables are normative in the MIPI M-PHY specification referenced by JESD220.

voltage_signaling.interface_rail: VCCQ2 (~1.8 V class) for the M-PHY/REF_CLK domain
voltage_signaling.termination: Impedance-controlled differential termination at HS gears
